1116-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-2872-3043.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-2872-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-3043.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-2534-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1170-2921-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-4094-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

553-7468-7735.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Quicksilver.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

431-6441-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-6441-6753-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2111-5315-6982.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Flesh Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more oil counters on it

112-3120-4050-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Mindsplice Apparatus.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3817-4200-5256.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1167-2636-3263-4096-5469.easyPrerequisites: Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
1167-2636-3263-4096-5469.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of the next person in turn order.
Move to the next turn. During that turn's untap step, untap all permanents you control due to Unwinding Clock and Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Trasnsmutation Font by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice the artifact token and return Mindslaver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat as long as you aren't next in turn order.

5170-6132-6559-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3875-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3875-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4002-4067-5181-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4067-5181-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

57-4235-4846-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-6968.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2608-5168-5542-6798.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
2608-5168-5542-6798.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2608-5168-5542-6798.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
2608-5168-5542-6798.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

977-1414-2051-5751-6747.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
977-1414-2051-5751-6747.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

280-1399-1606-4875.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

628-2099-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2099-5490.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3259-3480-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-1879-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2493-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2493-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Archaeomancer and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

141-3047-5147.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

293-1930-2393-5220.description:
Activate Undercity Informer by paying {1} and sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Undercity Informer ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3959-4050-4763-5177.description:
Cast Doomed Traveler by paying {W}.
Doomed Traveler enters the battlefield, triggering Veteran's Armaments, attaching it to Doomed Traveler.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Doomed Traveler, adding {W}.
Doomed Traveler dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Doomed Traveler's trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit token.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Doomed Traveler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times, adding infinite mana.

1020-2178-3689-4497.notablePrerequisites:
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Slobad.
1020-2178-3689-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Workshop Assistant dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Myr Retriever dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.

338-1874-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1874-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the amount of life gained.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2532-4050-4730.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4050-4730.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
The Sparring Mummy token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {R}.
The Sparring Mummy token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-844-1789-2232.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

774-3861-4826.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Orzhov Basilica for {W}{B}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Orzhov Basilica to your hand.
Repeat.

2556-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
2556-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
